newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, APRIL 22 - FRIDAY, MAY 2.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, APRIL 22 - FRIDAY, MAY 2.

text.p: COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-66/95 Sutton: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 79/7/EEC of December 19, 1978, on the progressive implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women in social security matters. Payments granted retroactively. Beneficiary's right to interest. - Judgment C-180/95 Draehmpaehl: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 2, paragraph 1 and 3, paragraph 1 of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. National law laying down conditions for the right to damages in cases of discrimination. Employer at fault. Damages limited to the equivalent of three months salary and six months when it is to be shared among several workers. - Judgment C-310/95 Road Air: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 132, paragraph 1, 133 paragraph 1 and 134. Validity of Council decision 86/283 of June 30, 1986, on the association of the overseas countries and territories with the European Economic Community, as well as Council decision 91/110/EEC of February 27, 1991. Nature of relations between the EU and the PTOM - free trade zone or customs union. Imports of goods freely traded in the Dutch Antilles but originally from another country. Customs exemption. Applicability. - Judgment C-395/95 P Geotronics v/ Commission: external relations. Appeal against judgment rendered October 26, 1995, in case T-185/94, Geotronics v/ Commission. Annulment of Commission decision of March 10, 1994, on a contract initially granted by the Romanian government following a tender for offers from the Commission in the framework of the PHARE programme. - Oral procedure C-391/95 Van Uden: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 5, point 1 and article 24 of the Brussels Convention. Competence to take provisional or protective measures. Interim ruling. Condemnation of debtor to payment of a sum as a provision. Arbitration on the basis of the litigation.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (enlarged)(0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure T-149/95 Ducros v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of Commission decision published May 16, 1995, to close the application procedure of EC treaty article 93, paragraph 2 and to authorise aids granted by the Italian government to public companies CMF SUD and CMF, in the form of public capital contributions following Italian authority commitments.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure T-290/94 Kayserberg v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision IV/M 430 of June 21, 1994, authorising the Procter and Gamble and Vereinigte Papierwerke Schickedanz merger. Substantial breach of form. Rights of the defence. Feminine hygiene products.

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-129/96 Inter-Environnement Wallonie: environment and consumers. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 5 and 189. Member states' power to take before the end of the term set for the transposition of a directive, dispositions (a) openly contrary to it or (b) substantially contrary to it, while presenting them as true transpositions. Interpretation of article 1(a) of Council directive 91/156/EEC modifying Council directive 74/442/EEC of July 15, 1975, on waste. Notion of waste. Substance addressed in annex I of the directive and integrated in an industrial process. - Opinion C-334/95 Kruger: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of Council regulation 804/68 of June 27, 1968, on common organisation in the milk and milk products sector and especially its annex as modified by regulation 374/92 insofar as it provides for no repayment on exports of milk in food preparations based on coffee essences or extracts, but does provide for food preparations based on coffee. Possible consequences of invalidity. Interpretation of Council regulation 2913/92 of October 12, 1992, laying down a Community customs code. 181148 OVR:BC-DIARY-COURT =2 Reuter European Court of Justice Diary (page 2/2)

FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-105/96 Codiesel: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Common Customs and Excise Tariff in effect in 1986, positions 84.53, 85.01 B II f and 85.04 B I. Electric appliance "uninterrupted power supply" (UPS). - Opinion C-142/96 Wacker Werke: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 13, paragraph 2, second line of Council regulation 2473/86, of July 24, 1986, on outward processing relief arrangements and the standard exchange system. Determination of the value of temporary import goods. Reasonable means. - (1000/0800 GMT) Oral procedure C-362/95 P Blackspur DIY v/ Council and Commission: trade policy. Appeal against Court judgment (first chamber enlarged), rendered September 18, 1995, in case T-168/94, Blackspur DIY v/ Council and Commission. Rejection of an action introduced on the basis of articles 178 and 215, paragraph 2 of EC treaty. Compensation for damages suffered following the imposition of a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of brushes from China.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-39/96 Free Record Shop: competition. Interpretation of EC treaty article 85 and of Council regulation 17 of February 6, 1962: first regulation applying articles 85 and 86. Agreement or decision of an association of companies on a system of imposed pricing on books. Conditions for the provisional accord notified to the Commission in 1962 and later amended in an insubstantial manner. - Opinion C-329/96 Commission v/ Greece: environment and consumers. Request for preliminary ruling. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 92/43/EEC of May 21, 1992, on the conservation of natural habitats and wild fauna and flora. - Opinion C-331/96 Commission v/ Greece: environment and consumers. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 92/72/EEC of September 21, 1992, on ozone air pollution. - Oral procedure C-117/96 Mosbaek: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 3 of Council directive 80/987/EEC of October 20, 1980, on the approximation of member state legislation on protection of salaried workers in cases of employer bankruptcy. Competent guarantee institution in the case of a worker employed in a member state other than the one in which the failed employer is based.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-145/96 van Hoffmann: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 9, paragraph 2(e), third hyphen of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Advisory, technical and research consultancy services and similar services. Activities of an arbitrator in the Paris International Chamber of Commerce. - Opinion C-309/95 Commission v/ Council: state aid. Annulment of Council decision of June 22, 1995, on the granting of an exceptional aid to French table wine producers. Application conditions of EC treaty article 93, paragraph, line three. - Oral procedure C-21/96 Commission v/ Spain: protection of the population. Non-respect. Failure to have correctly and completely transposed articles 3 and 5 of Council directive 84/466/EURATOM of September 3, 1984, laying down fundamental measures on radiological protection of persons undergoing medical examinations and treatments. - Oral procedure C-276/96 Commission v/ Portugal: protection of the population. Non-respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period article 3 of Council directive 84/466/EURATOM of September 3, 1984, laying down fundamental measures on radiological protection of persons undergoing medical examinations and treatments.

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-251/95 SABEL: approximation of legislation. - Opinion C-337/95 Parfums Christian Dior: free movement of goods. - Oral procedure C-188/95 Fantask: taxation.
FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-366/95 Steff-Houlberg Export: proper Community resources.
SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-36/96 Guenaydin: external relations. - Opinion C-98/96 Ertanir: external relations. - Opinion C-165/95 Lay: agriculture.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-152/95 Petrides v/ Commission: agriculture.
